name_zh: 祖龙辉剑【希望之辉】 - Lv.3

name: Lightbreak Blade 1
description: A Great Sword with tremendous, volatile power that leaves no trace of victims in its wake.
description_de: Ein Großschwert mit volatiler Macht. Lässt keine Spur seiner Opfer zurück.
description_fr: Grande épée à la puissance volatile extrême. Elle ne laisse aucune trace de ses victimes.
description_es: Gran espada con un poder tremendo y volátil que desintegra a sus víctimas completamente.
description_it: Spadone dalla potenza esplosiva che annienta gli avversari senza lasciarne traccia.
description_zh: A Great Sword with tremendous, volatile power that leaves no trace of victims in its wake.

name: Lightbreak Ash 2
description: The Lightbreak Blade's final form. Its explosive power can destroy the world if improperly used.
description_de: Die finale Form der Lichtbruch- Klinge. Unachtsam gehandhabt kann ihre Kraft die Welt zerstören.
description_fr: Un mauvais maniement de cette arme pourrait détruire le monde. Base : Lame de lumière
description_es: Forma final de Filo parteluz. Su fuerza explosiva es capaz de destruir el mundo.
description_it: La forma finale della lama d'alba. Se usata impropriamente, può distruggere il mondo intero.
description_zh: The Lightbreak Blade's final form. Its explosive power can destroy the world if improperly used.

name: Lightbreak Ember 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Lightbreak Blade.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Lichtbruch-Klinge.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Lame de lumière.
description_es: Forma perfecta Filo parteluz que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della lama d'alba.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Lightbreak Blade.

name: Licht/Ombre 1
description: A wicked blade whose Affinity changes when its wielder overcomes the Frenzy.
description_de: Eine üble Klinge, deren Affinität wechselt, wenn ihr Träger die Raserei überwindet.
description_fr: Une lame diabolique dont l'affinité change quand son porteur triomphe du virus de la furie.
description_es: Espada retorcida cuya afinidad cambia cuando su portador supera la cólera.
description_it: Lama malvagia la cui affinità muta quando chi la brandisce debella la frenesia.
description_zh: A wicked blade whose Affinity changes when its wielder overcomes the Frenzy.

name: Düster/Éclat 2
description: The Licht/Ombre's final form. Shows its true potential only to those who would shatter the dark.
description_de: Finale Form von Licht und Schatten. Zeigt ihre wahre Macht jenen, die die Dunkelheit bekämpfen.
description_fr: Ne révèle son véritable potentiel qu'à ceux qui bravent les ténèbres. Base : Licht/Ombre
description_es: Forma final de Licth/Sombra. Muestra su verdadero potencial solo a quienes destruyen la oscuridad.
description_it: La forma finale della Licht-Ombre. Se usata impropriamente, può distruggere il mondo intero.
description_zh: The Licht/Ombre's final form. Shows its true potential only to those who would shatter the dark.

description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della Licht-Ombre.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Licht/Ombre.

name: Quarrel Hornsword 1
description: A wild-looking, considerably powerful blade crafted from Diablos horns.
description_de: Eine gefährlich wirkende Klinge aus Diablos-Hörnern. Sehr schlagkräftig.
description_fr: Épée farouche faite en cornes de Diablos. Très puissante.
description_es: De aspecto feroz. Hecha de cuernos de Diablos. Muy poderosa.
description_it: Lama dall'aspetto selvatico fatta con corna di Diablos. È potentissima.
description_zh: A wild-looking, considerably powerful blade crafted from Diablos horns.

name: Feud Hornsword 2
description: The Quarrel Hornsword's final form. Whatever calls forth its true power must be terrible indeed.
description_de: Finale Form des Streit-Hornschwerts. Was auch immer seine wahre Macht erweckt, muss schrecklich sein.
description_fr: Sa puissance cachée est terrifiante. Base : Épée en corne colère
description_es: Forma final de Espada cuerno riña. El origen de su verdadero poder es espeluznante.
description_it: La forma finale della spada corno alterco. La crudeltà risveglia tutto il suo potere.
description_zh: The Quarrel Hornsword's final form. Whatever calls forth its true power must be terrible indeed.

name: Icicle Fang 1
description: A blade that freezes foes solid; a manifestation of the white- knight ruler of the Tundra.
description_de: Eine Klinge, die Feinde ge- frieren lässt. Die Manifes- tation des Tundraherrschers.
description_fr: Lame gelant les ennemis. Manifestation du chevalier blanc de la Toundra.
description_es: Espada que congela enemigos. Manifestación del caballero blanco de la tundra.
description_it: Lama che incarna il bianco della tundra e congela nemici in un solido blocco.
description_zh: A blade that freezes foes solid; a manifestation of the white- knight ruler of the Tundra.

name: Paladire 2
description: The Icicle Fang's final form. One strike can freeze the deepest ocean -- and shatter it.
description_de: Finale Form des Eiszapfen-Reißzahns. Ein einziger Schlag gefriert - und zerschmettert - den tiefsten Ozean!
description_fr: On la dit capable de congeler et briser un océan entier. Base : Croc stalactite
description_es: Forma final de Colmillo carámbano. Con un solo golpe congela el mar más profundo... y lo parte en dos.
description_it: La forma finale della zanna di ghiaccio. Un solo colpo può congelare l'oceano più profondo.
description_zh: The Icicle Fang's final form. One strike can freeze the deepest ocean -- and shatter it.

name: Carapace Sword 1
description: A blade shaped like a Barroth's head; it packs nearly as much punch.
description_de: Eine Klinge in Form eines Barroth-Kopfes; sie ist auch beinahe genauso hart.
description_fr: Épée en forme de tête de Barroth. A presque autant de vigueur.
description_es: Con la forma de la cabeza de un Barroth y casi con la misma fuerza.
description_it: Una lama a forma di testa di Barroth e con quasi la stessa forza.
description_zh: A blade shaped like a Barroth's head; it packs nearly as much punch.

description: The Carapace Sword's final form. To see one of its earth-gouging attacks is to tremble with fear.
description_de: Finale Form des Rückenpanzer- schwerts. Ihre Angriffe durchdringen die Erde - ein Anblick zum Fürchten.
description_fr: La simple vue de cette arme en action suffit à inspirer la terreur. Base : Épée carapace
description_es: Forma final de Espada de caparazón. Su golpe capaz de destrozar la tierra es aterrador.
description_it: Forma finale della spada di carapace. Vedere uno dei suoi attacchi distruttivi fa rabbrividire.

name: Immane Blade 1
description: A blade that leverages the Nerscylla's unique materials to exceed Forge limits.
description_de: Überwindet mit einmaligem Nerscylla-Material die Grenzen der Schmiedekunst.
description_fr: Lame à base de Nerscylla qui repousse les limites de la forge.
description_es: Espada que usa el material de Nerscylla para sobrepasar los límites de la forja.
description_it: Sfrutta le proprietà uniche del Nerscylla per superare i limiti della Forgia.

description_de: Finale Form der Immensen Klinge. Ihre Schläge haben die Kraft, die Ziele völlig zu zerfetzen.
description_fr: Rien ne peut résister à son tranchant. Base : Lame du sacrificateur
description_es: Forma final de Espada imponente. Su cortante filo tiene la capacidad de mutilar al adversario.
description_it: Forma finale della lama immane. Possiede un'affilatezza tale da mutilare gli avversari.

name: Scylla Blade 1
description: An augmented, advanced blade so dreadfully sharp that it can split any prey in two.
description_de: Verbesserte fortgeschrittene Klinge. So scharf, dass sie jede Beute halbieren kann.
description_fr: Épée améliorée si tranchante qu'elle peut fendre en deux n'importe quelle proie.
description_es: Espada mejorada y avanzada. Tan afilada que es capaz de cortar en dos a la presa.
description_it: Lama talmente evoluta e sofisticata da poter tranciare qualunque preda.
description_zh: An augmented, advanced blade so dreadfully sharp that it can split any prey in two.

name: Scylla Razor 2
description: The Scylla Blade's final form makes use of the original's dreadful sharpness and takes it even further.
description_de: Die finale Form der Nerscylla-Klinge, jetzt mit noch schärferer Schneide als das Original.
description_fr: Cette forme améliore davantage le tranchant de son modèle d'origine. Base : Lame Nerscylla
description_es: Forma final de Espada Scylla. Más afilada y letal que el modelo original.
description_it: Forma finale della lama Scylla. Ancora più affilata e temibile dell'originale.
description_zh: The Scylla Blade's final form makes use of the original's dreadful sharpness and takes it even further.

description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Scylla Blade.

name: Reddnaught 1
description: A famous weapon once wielded by a fearless hero. It loathes cowardice, but aids courage.
description_de: Die einstige Waffe eines furchtlosen Helden. Sie hilft nur den Mutigen.
description_fr: Arme célèbre jadis maniée par un héros intrépide. Hait les lâches, aide les braves.
description_es: Famosa arma empuñada por un intrépido héroe. Detesta la cobardía y da valor.
description_it: Arma famosa appartenuta a un eroe impavido. Odia i codardi e aiuta i coraggiosi.
description_zh: A famous weapon once wielded by a fearless hero. It loathes cowardice, but aids courage.

name: Super Reddnaught 2
description: The Reddnaught's final form. It will help the courageous along the path of the hero.
description_de: Finale Form des Fürchtenichts. Geleitet die Mutigen auf dem Pfad zur Heldenhaftigkeit.
description_fr: Aide les cœurs vaillants à devenir des héros accomplis. Base : Reddnaught
description_es: Forma final de Blindada roja. Ayuda a los valientes a avanzar por el camino del héroe.
description_it: Forma finale del coraggio cremisi. Aiuta gli audaci nelle loro missioni eroiche.
description_zh: The Reddnaught's final form. It will help the courageous along the path of the hero.

description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore del coraggio cremisi.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Reddnaught.

name: Research Great Sword 1
description: A Sword intended for the guard of the Soaratorium. Also functions as a meticulous compass.
description_de: Ein Schwert für die Wache des Aerotoriums. Fungiert außerdem als eleganter Kompass.
description_fr: Épée destinée aux gardes de l'Aérolabo. C'est aussi une boussole de précision.
description_es: Gran espada creada para defender el Flotatorio. También sirve como brújula de gran precisión.
description_it: Una spada pensata per le guardie del solcacieli. Funziona anche da bussola, se necessario.
description_zh: A Sword intended for the guard of the Soaratorium. Also functions as a meticulous compass.

name: Discovery Great Sword 2
description: The Research Great Sword's final form. It offers direction to those who follow the pen and sword.
description_de: Finale Form des Rätsel-Groß- schwerts. Ein Weiser sprach: "Studie- re die Schriften und folge mir nach."
description_fr: Sert de repère à ceux qui ont choisi de suivre la plume et l'épée. Base : Grande épée d'étude
description_es: Forma final de Gran espada investigación. Guía a quien valora tanto la pluma como la espada.
description_it: Forma finale dello spadone della ricerca. Mostra la via a coloro che seguono la penna e la spada.

name: Viking Hornsword 1
description: A blade crafted from a giant horn, Ceadeus's pride. It shines with foes' blood.
description_de: Klinge aus einem riesigen Horn, Ceadeus' Stolz. Es glänzt von feindlichem Blut.
description_fr: Lame créée avec une corne géante, fierté de Ceadeus. Brille du sang des ennemis.
description_es: Hecha de un gran cuerno. Orgullo de los Cadeus; con la sangre enemiga brilla.
description_it: Lama creata con il grande corno orgoglio dei Ceadeus. Brilla col sangue nemico.
description_zh: A blade crafted from a giant horn, Ceadeus's pride. It shines with foes' blood.

name: Ancharius Sword 2
description: The Viking Hornsword's final form. A sea god's soul slumbers within, causing it to glow dully.
description_de: Finale Form des Wikinger-Horn- schwerts. Glüht schwach, weil darin die Seele eines Meeresgottes ruht.
description_fr: Renferme l'âme d'une divinité des profondeurs marines. Base : Épée en corne Viking
description_es: Forma final de Espada cuerno vikinga. En su luz mora el alma de un dios marino.
description_it: Forma finale della spada corno vichinga. L'anima di un dio del mare all'interno la fa brillare fiocamente.

description_fr: Relique d'une civilisation oubliée. L'inscription évoque un roi qui tyrannisait son peuple.
description_es: Reliquia de una civilización perdida. La inscripción habla de un rey tirano.

description_zh: Golden relic of a lost civilization. The inscription tells of a king who brutally oppressed his people.

name: Inscribed Ausir 2
description: The Goldsword's final form. Possibly god-made, its forging remains a mystery.

description_es: Forma final de Espada áurica. Su origen es un misterio, pero se dice que fue forjada por un dios.

description_zh: A Sword that dispels darkness. Said to vibrate at the sound of a Dragon's roar.

name: True Ruiner Sword 2
description: The final form of the Ruiner Sword, slayer of thousands of dragons. Will sever even vengeance.
description_de: Finale Form des Schwarzen Ruinschwerts. Hat bereits Tausende von Drachen erschlagen.
description_fr: Son tranchant a mis fin à la vie de mille dragons. Base : Épée clair-obscur
description_es: Forma final de Espada destructora negra, asesina de mil dragones. Puede cortar hasta la venganza.
description_it: La forma finale della spada Rovina nera, che ha abbattuto mille draghi. Può squarciare la vendetta stessa.
description_zh: The final form of the Ruiner Sword, slayer of thousands of dragons. Will sever even vengeance.

name: Absolute Ruiner Sword 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ruiner Sword.

description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Épée clair-obscur.

description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ruiner Sword.

name: O. Fatalis Sword 1
description: An accursed Sword from an old Fatalis. Its wielder must dance its dance until death.
description_de: Verfluchtes Schwert eines alten Fatalis. Lässt den Träger tanzen bis zum bitteren Ende.
description_fr: Épée maudite à base de Fatalis ancien. Celui qui la brandit doit suivre sa danse jusqu'à la mort.
description_es: Una espada maldita de Fatalis ancestral. Su portador debe bailar a su son hasta la muerte.
description_it: Spada maledetta di Fatalis antico. Chi la brandisce deve danzare al suo ritmo fino alla morte.
description_zh: An accursed Sword from an old Fatalis. Its wielder must dance its dance until death.

description_es: Forma final de Espada Fatalis Ancestral. Solo para quienes hayan roto la maldición del Fatalis.

name: Lightbreak Sword 1
description: A Sword & Shield that stir the earth with explosive tirades, devouring all in sight.
description_de: Schwert & Schild, das die Erde mit explosiven Tiraden erzittern lässt, die alles verschlingen.
description_fr: Épée & bouclier qui secoue la terre de ses explosions et dévore tout sur son passage.
description_es: Espada y escudo que agitan la tierra con poderosas explosiones que lo devoran todo a su paso.
description_it: Spada e scudo che scuotono la terra con raffiche esplosive, annientando ciò che incontrano.
description_zh: A Sword & Shield that stir the earth with explosive tirades, devouring all in sight.

name: Lightbreak Ray 2
description: The Lightbreak Sword's final form. Once it surpasses the critical point, everything it touches will vaporize.
description_de: Finale Form des Lichtbruch-Schwerts. Vaporisiert alles bei Berührung, wenn der kritische Punkt erreicht ist.
description_fr: Vaporise tout ce qu'elle touche une fois son point critique atteint. Base : Épée de lumière
description_es: Forma final de Espada parteluz. Cuando supera el punto crítico, vaporiza todo lo que toca.
description_it: La forma finale della spada e scudo d'alba. Una volta superato il punto critico, vaporizza tutto ciò che tocca.
description_zh: The Lightbreak Sword's final form. Once it surpasses the critical point, everything it touches will vaporize.

name: Icicle Spike 1
description: A Sword of extreme cold. Its blade can pierce shells to freeze prey from the inside.
description_de: Ein extrem kaltes Schwert. Durch Panzer gestoßen, lässt es seine Gegner gefrieren.
description_fr: Épée glaciale. Sa lame traverse la carapace et gèle sa proie de l'intérieur.
description_es: Espada de frío extremo. Su hoja perfora los caparazones y congela desde dentro.
description_it: Spada estremamente fredda con una lama che perfora le corazze e congela la preda dall'interno.
description_zh: A Sword of extreme cold. Its blade can pierce shells to freeze prey from the inside.

description_fr: Épée cruelle plongeant tout dans l'oubli. Aurait soumis les dieux du feu.
description_es: Espada cruel que envía todo al olvido. Dicen que sometió a los dioses del fuego.
description_it: Spada crudele che consegna ogni cosa all'oblio. Pare che abbia messo in ginocchio anche gli dei.

description_fr: Rares sont les créatures capables de résister à son froid transperçant. Base : Croix cryo
description_es: Forma final de Criocruz. Raro es el ser que pueda soportar su gélido filo.
description_it: La forma finale della croce congelante. Quasi nessuno resiste alla sua puntura di ghiaccio.

name: Bloodsquama Sword 2
description: The Bloodscale Sword's final form. The secrets of its creation make the blade seem bloodstained.
description_de: Finale Form des Blutschuppen- schwerts. Seine Sekrete lassen die Klinge blutverschmiert aussehen.
description_fr: Cette épée et ce bouclier semblent constamment maculés de sang. Base : Écailles de sang
description_es: Forma final de Escama sangrienta. Se fabricó de tal forma que la hoja parece manchada de sangre.
description_it: Forma finale della spada sanguiscaglia. Quali segreti celano quelle macchie di sangue?
description_zh: The Bloodscale Sword's final form. The secrets of its creation make the blade seem bloodstained.

name: Bloodslaughter 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Bloodscale Sword.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe des Blutschuppenschwerts.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Écailles de sang.

description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della spada sanguiscaglia.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Bloodscale Sword.

name: Platinum Dawn 1
description: An ancient, light-bringing Sword & Shield blessed by the Gold Queen and Silver King.
description_de: Altes, lichtbringendes Schwert & Schild mit dem Segen der Goldkönigin und des Silberkönigs.
description_fr: Épée et bouclier anciens légers, bénis par la Reine d'or et le Roi d'argent.
description_es: Espada y escudo antiguos y que portan la luz bendecidos por la reina dorada y el rey plateado.
description_it: Spada e scudo antichi e lucenti benedetti dal re argenteo e dalla regina dorata.
description_zh: An ancient, light-bringing Sword & Shield blessed by the Gold Queen and Silver King.

name: Annular Sol 2
description: The Platinum Dawn's final form. Its brilliant blade chases away the deepest darknesses.
description_de: Finale Form der Platin-Dämmerung. Die funkelnde Klinge verbrennt geradezu die Dunkelheit.
description_fr: Cette épée et ce bouclier dissipent les ténèbres. Base : Aube platine
description_es: Forma final de Amanecer de platino. Su brillante hoja disipa el manto de la oscuridad.
description_it: Forma finale dell'alba di platino. La sua lama scintillante dissipa l'oscurità.
description_zh: The Platinum Dawn's final form. Its brilliant blade chases away the deepest darknesses.

name: Daybreak Sun 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Platinum Dawn.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Platin-Dämmerung.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Aube platine.

description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore dell'alba di platino.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Platinum Dawn.

name: Binding Blade 1
description: Crafted by popular demand, this is the ultimate binding sword with G-rank power.
description_de: Aufgrund der großen Nachfrage entwickeltes Schwert mit ultimativer Bindungskraft auf G-Rang.
description_fr: Ce couteau courbé a été créé pour répondre à une forte demande.
description_es: Arma con potencia de rango G. Forjada gracias a su popular demanda.
description_it: Arma di potenza di grado G, creata per venire incontro alla grande richiesta.
description_zh: Crafted by popular demand, this is the ultimate binding sword with G-rank power.

name: Great Kris 2
description: The Binding Blade's final form. Hundreds of hours of painstaking research led to its creation.
description_de: Finale Form der Bindungsklinge. Seiner Erschaffung ging lange und schmerzhafte Forschung voraus.
description_fr: Cette arme n'a pu être créée qu'au prix de longs et nombreux efforts. Base : Lame reliée
description_es: Forma final de Hoja enlazada. Su proceso de creación fue largo y doloroso.
description_it: Forma finale della lama avvolgente. La sua forgiatura ha richiesto centinaia di ore di ricerca.
description_zh: The Binding Blade's final form. Hundreds of hours of painstaking research led to its creation.

name: Bloodsucker 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Binding Blade.

name: Drome Rush Dagger 1
description: A weapon based on how monsters' claws are used for both attack and defense.
description_de: Basiert auf der Verwendung von Monsterklauen für Angriff und Verteidigung.
description_fr: Tire profit de ses crocs de monstres pour optimiser l'attaque et la défense.
description_es: Arma inspirada en la forma en que los monstruos usan sus garras.
description_it: Arma che riproduce l'uso offensivo e difensivo degli artigli di mostro.
name_zh: 蓝速龙王斩刺短剑 - Lv.1
description_zh: A weapon based on how monsters' claws are used for both attack and defense.

name: Great Stabberdag 2
description: The Drome Rush Dagger's final form. Lash out at enemies as a wild beast would shred with its claws.
description_de: Finale Form des Velocidrome-Hast- dolchs. Zerreißt alles mit seinen Klauen wie eine wilde Bestie.
description_fr: Elle tranche la chair avec la férocité d'une bête qui se bat pour sa vie. Base : Dague double assaut
description_es: Forma final de Daga avalancha Drome. Ataca al enemigo con la fuerza de una bestia salvaje.
description_it: Forma finale del pugnale impeto Drome. Attacca i nemici come gli artigli di un animale selvaggio.
name_zh: 蓝速龙王突进短剑 - Lv.2
description_zh: The Drome Rush Dagger's final form. Lash out at enemies as a wild beast would shred with its claws.

description_es: Forma perfecta Daga avalancha Drome que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore del pugnale impeto Drome.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Drome Rush Dagger.

name: Research Sword 1
description: A weapon fit for a sleuth. The blade serves as a magnifying glass, and the shield doubles as a compass.

description_es: Hecha para realizar pesquisas. La hoja sirve de lupa, y el escudo, de brújula.

description: The Research Sword's final form. According to the sages, it points the way to unlimited scholarship.

name: Wycademy Dagger 1
description: A blade that opens doors to wisdom that perseverance alone cannot unlock.
description_de: Die Klinge öffnet Türen zur Weisheit, die Hartnäckigkeit allein nicht zu knacken vermag.

description_fr: Offre à son porteur une source sans fond de connaissances. Base : Dague wycadémique

description_it: Forma finale del pugnale Wyccademia. Aiuta a proseguire sulla via dell'onniscienza.

name: Elder Sword 1
description: A Sword from the Soaratorium for hunters breaking new ground. Tough and flexible in equal measure.

description_fr: Conçue par la Wycadémie pour les chasseurs à l'avant-garde, elle allie robustesse et souplesse avec brio.

description_it: Ideata dal solcacieli per il cacciatore pioniere. Resistente e flessibile.
description_zh: A Sword from the Soaratorium for hunters breaking new ground. Tough and flexible in equal measure.

name: Sage Sword 2
description: The Elder Sword's final form. It's light, but capable of dealing devastating attacks.

description_fr: Malgré sa légèreté, ses attaques sont d'une puissance dévastatrice. Base : Épée des anciens

name: Xin's Trust 1
description: A sword inherited by a would-be general, and a shield that stirs passion.

description_zh: Xin's Trust's final form. Believe in its true worth, and it shall be so.

name: Falchion 1
description: A legendary sword that, along with the Sealing Shield, the righteous wield in battle.
description_de: Ein legendäres Schwert, das die Gerechten mit dem Siegel- schild in die Schlacht führen.
description_fr: Épée légendaire. Le héros l'utilise avec l'Écu scelleur pour rétablir la justice.
description_es: Espada legendaria que, junto con el Escudo de sellos, blande quien lucha por la justicia.
description_it: Spada leggendaria che, assieme allo Scudo dei Sigilli, accompagna i più valorosi in battaglia.

description_it: Forma finale di Falchion. Capace di sigillare le forze del male e riportare armonia nel mondo.
description_zh: The final form of the Falchion can seal the forces of evil and restore harmony to the world.

name: Black Kitty Stamp 1
description: Made to resemble a black cat with a devious smile. A rare, highly desired color.

name: Egg Hammer 1
description: This Hammer smashes the notion that hammers need to be hard. It's a mystery why it never breaks.
description_de: Der Hammer beweist, dass Hämmer nicht hart sein müssen. Warum er nicht zerbricht, ist ein Rätsel.
description_fr: Ce marteau écrase la notion qui veut que les marteaux soient durs. Incassable, inexplicablement.
description_es: Este martillo rompe con la idea de que un martillo debe ser duro. Misteriosamente, nunca se rompe.
description_it: Sgretola l'idea che un martello debba essere duro. Strano ma vero, non si rompe mai.

name: Goldhammer 1
description: Golden relic of a lost civilization. The inscription tells of a feminine force that birthed the world.

name: Inscribed Hathor 2
description: The Goldhammer's final form. Created by the bringer of life and heaven's mistress, Hathor.

description_es: Forma final de Martillo áurico. Creado por Hathor, señora celestial que engendra vida.
description_it: La forma finale del martello ornato, creato da Hathor, divinità portatrice di vita.

name: Silverwing Hammer 1
description: Shines with the silvery hue of the Argent Comet. As dense as an iron star, its impact is merciless.
description_de: Leuchtet mit dem silbernen Schimmer des Valstrax und hat die Dichte eines Eisensterns.
description_fr: Marteau rappelant le Valstrax. Aussi dense qu'un astre de fer, il ne connaît aucune pitié.
description_es: Irradia un fulgor plateado como el de un Valstrax. Denso como el acero estelar y de impacto demoledor.
description_it: Risplende con il colore argenteo di un Valstrax. Denso come una stella d'acciaio e dal forte impatto.
description_zh: Shines with the silvery hue of the Argent Comet. As dense as an iron star, its impact is merciless.

description_fr: "Craignez-moi, moi qui réduis les astres au néant absolu." Base : Marteau Ailargent
description_es: Forma final de Martillo ala plata. Su inscripción reza: "Plegaos ante mi fuerza de aniquilación estelar".

description_zh: The Silverwing Hammer's final form. "Fear me, the star-crusher; in the end, naught will remain."

name: Vermilion Rim 1
description: Only dragon slayers are allowed to use this weapon, but those who do, wipe out dragons easily.
description_de: Nur Drachentöter dürfen diese Waffe führen. Und sie führen sie ausgesprochen gut.
description_fr: Seuls les tueurs de dragons sont autorisés à manier cette arme redoutable contre les wyvernes.
description_es: Solo los matadragones pueden usar esta arma capaz de matar a un dragón en cuestión de segundos.
description_it: Solo i trucidadraghi possono usare quest'arma, con la quale sconfiggere i draghi è un gioco da ragazzi.
description_zh: Only dragon slayers are allowed to use this weapon, but those who do, wipe out dragons easily.

name: Draconic Rim 2
description: The Vermilion Rim's final form. Hits with the ferocity of a dragon's charge.
description_de: Finale Form des Zinnoberrands. Schlägt so hart zu, wie ein Drache voranstürmt.
description_fr: Frappe avec la férocité d'un dragon en pleine charge. Base : Pointe vermillon
description_es: Forma final de Borde bermejo. Golpea con la misma ferocidad que una embestida de dragón.
description_it: Forma finale delle budella vermiglie. Colpisce con la ferocia di un drago.
description_zh: The Vermilion Rim's final form. Hits with the ferocity of a dragon's charge.

description_es: Forma perfecta Borde bermejo que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore delle budella vermiglie.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Vermilion Rim.

name: Ruiner Lance 1
description: A Dragon Lance that dispels darkness. Pulsates when a dragon is near.
description_de: Eine Drachenlanze, die die Dunkelheit vertreibt. Pulsiert in der Nähe von Drachen.
description_fr: Lance dissipant les ombres. Ses battements indiquent qu'une wyverne est proche.
description_es: Venablo de dragón que disipa la oscuridad. Sus venas laten si hay un wyvern.
description_it: Può dissipare l'oscurità. Il pulsare delle vene indica che c'è un wyvern vicino.
description_zh: A Dragon Lance that dispels darkness. Pulsates when a dragon is near.

name: True Ruiner Lance 2
description: The Ruiner Lance's final form is capable of piercing through its prey's heart and soul.
description_de: Finale Form der Schwarzen Ruinlanze. Kann Herz und Seele ihrer Beute durchbohren.
description_fr: Lance capable de percer jusqu'à l'âme de sa victime. Base : Lance clair-obscur
description_es: Forma final de Lanza destructora negra. Es capaz de perforar el corazón y el alma de su presa.
description_it: Forma finale della lancia rovina nera. È in grado di perforare il cuore e l'anima della sua preda.
description_zh: The Ruiner Lance's final form is capable of piercing through its prey's heart and soul.

description_es: Forma perfecta Lanza destructora negra que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della lancia rovina nera.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ruiner Lance.

name: O. Fatalis Lance 1
description: A ghostly Lance with an old Fatalis's gleam. It races across the earth like a divine ray.

description_fr: Cette lance spectrale a l'éclat du Fatalis ancien. Elle parcourt la terre comme un rayon divin.
description_es: Lanza fantasmal con el brillo del Fatalis ancestral. Se desliza sobre la tierra como un rayo.
description_it: Lancia spettrale con riflessi di Fatalis antico. Corre sulla terra come un raggio divino.
description_zh: A ghostly Lance with an old Fatalis's gleam. It races across the earth like a divine ray.

name: True O. Fatalis Lance 2
description: The O. Fatalis Lance's final form could even pierce through the realm of the gods.
description_de: Finale Form der Alter-Fatalis-Lanze. Fähig, das Reich der Götter selbst zu durchdringen.
description_fr: Même le trône des dieux n'est pas à l'abri de sa pointe. Base : Lance Fatalis ancien
description_es: Forma final de Venablo Fatalis Ancestral. Podría atravesar hasta el mismísimo reino de los dioses.
description_it: Forma finale della lancia Fatalis antico. Potrebbe penetrare persino il regno degli dèi.

description_zh: A Lance whose belligerent blaze conquers the world with the swiftness and finality of magma.

description_fr: Consume ses victimes avec la puissance d'une nuée ardente. Base : Lance de lumière
description_es: Forma final de Lanza parteluz. Su poder envuelve a las presas como un flujo piroclástico.
description_it: Forma finale della lancia d'alba. Può travolgere la sua preda come una colata piroclastica.
description_zh: The Lightbreak Lance's final form overpowers its prey like a pyroclastic flow.

name: Daito Crow 1
description: True loneliness is known only by the blade that has lost even its owner.
description_de: Wahre Einsamkeit kennt nur die Klinge, die sogar ihren Besitzer verloren hat.
description_fr: On dit que l'épéiste était seul par force, mais l'épée était seule par perte.
description_es: La soledad de un espadachín en su poder nunca igualará a la de una espada huérfana de amo.
description_it: Solo la lama che ha perso il suo proprietario conosce la vera solitudine.
description_zh: True loneliness is known only by the blade that has lost even its owner.

name: Daito Bane 1
description: A sword that has outlived generations of kings and cut down countless menaces.
description_de: Ein Schwert, das zahllose Könige überlebt und unzählige Bedrohungen beseitigt hat.
description_fr: A survécu à des générations de rois et triomphé d'innombrables menaces.
description_es: Espada que ha sobrevivido a generaciones de reyes, y acabado con muchas amenazas.
description_it: Spada sopravvissuta a generazioni di re sventando infinite minacce.

description_de: Ein Langschwert aus Anteka- Teilen, legt Wert auf Effizienz, nicht auf Optik.
description_fr: Épée longue en Anteka. Apparence anodine, mais parmi les plus maniables.

name: Fatalis Scythe 1
description: The great scythe of red fury. Be as Death and soak the world in despair.

description_de: Ein Langschwert aus Basarios-Teilen. Überwältigt Feinde sofort mit seinem Gewicht und seiner Schärfe.
description_fr: Son poids et son tranchant viennent rapidement à bout des défenses de ses victimes.

description: Formed from Barioth parts, this amber blade leaves gouts of bloody ice in its wake.
description_de: Aus Barioth-Teilen gefertigt, hinterlässt die Waffe literweise Blut auf dem Eis.
description_fr: Épée en Barioth qui laisse tomber constamment des gouttes de sang glacé sur son sillage.
description_es: Hecha con partes de Barioth. Su hoja carmesí mancha el hielo con la sangre de sus víctimas.
description_it: Spada ambrata forgiata con parti di Barioth. I suoi fendenti lasciano fiotti di sangue sul ghiaccio.
description_zh: Formed from Barioth parts, this amber blade leaves gouts of bloody ice in its wake.

description_de: Finale Form der Bastine-Schneide. Lobet den Schmied, der kälteerzeu- gendes Material verarbeiten kann.

description_es: Forma final de Hoja Bastine. Gloria a los herreros que trabajan con materiales que generan frío.

name: Blood Cry 1
description: A sharp Long Sword as slim as a Nerscylla leg. Creep in close and kill prey swiftly.
description_de: Scharfes Langschwert, dünn wie Nerscylla-Beine. Bringt im Nahkampf schnellen Tod.
description_fr: Épée affûtée aussi élancée qu'une patte de Nerscylla. Furtive et mortelle.
description_es: Espada larga delgada como la pata del Nerscylla. Acércate y mata limpiamente.
description_it: Spada lunga e sottile come una zampa di Nerscylla, per uccisioni rapide e furtive.

description_fr: Cette lame gracile a été renforcée pour gagner en solidité. Base : Cri du sang
description_es: Forma final de Grito sangriento. Espada que ha sido mejorada para dotarla de más robustez.
description_it: Forma finale del grido sanguinario. Potenziata con uno strato extra che le dona eccezionale solidità.

name: Noble Blood Cry 1
description: A Long Sword made from Nerscylla parts sharpened to such an extent, foes don't even notice they're cut.
description_de: Aus Nerscylla-Beinen. Die scharfe Schneide ist schnell wie ein Gutenachtkuss.
description_fr: Fabriquée avec des pattes de Nerscylla. Sa lame acérée est aussi vive qu'un baiser.
description_es: Espada hecha con una pata de Nerscylla. Su hoja es rápida como un beso de buenas noches.
description_it: Ricavata da zampe di Nerscylla. La sua lama è rapida come una carezza.
description_zh: A Long Sword made from Nerscylla parts sharpened to such an extent, foes don't even notice they're cut.

name: Optimus 2
description: The Noble Blood Cry's final form. The blade always seem to wend its way towards its victims' hearts.
description_de: Finale Form des Edlen Blutschreis. Windet sich so, dass sie immer das Herz des Gegners durchstößt.
description_fr: Cette lame semble inextricablement attirée par le cœur de ses victimes. Base : Cri du sang noble
description_es: La forma final de Gran grito sangriento. Su hoja siempre se clava en el corazón de sus víctimas.
description_it: Forma finale del grido sanguinario nobile. La sua lama arriva sempre al cuore delle sue vittime.
description_zh: The Noble Blood Cry's final form. The blade always seem to wend its way towards its victims' hearts.

name: Roguemaster 1
description: A Long Sword adorned with the Great Maccao's colorful plumage. Go on, flaunt your wild side.
description_de: Mit prächtigen Maccao-Federn geschmücktes Langschwert. Verleiht das Charisma, Schurken anzuführen.
description_fr: Épée longue décorée de plumes de Grand Maccao, faite pour ceux qui aiment l'extravagance.
description_es: Espada larga adornada con plumas coloridas de Gran Maccao. ¿Te gusta lo exótico?
description_it: Spada decorata con piume variopinte di Gran Maccao. Bellezza e fascino malvagi.
description_zh: A Long Sword adorned with the Great Maccao's colorful plumage. Go on, flaunt your wild side.

name: Gangmaster 2
description: Power alone is not enough--the Roguemaster's final form has a truly despicable appeal.
description_de: Finale Form des Räuberhauptmanns. Strahlt die Kraft eines Anführers aus, der sich nicht nur auf Stärke verlässt.
description_fr: La force de cette lame réside dans l'aura sordide qu'elle dégage. Base : Roi des voleurs
description_es: Forma final de Jefe rebelde. Además de ser muy poderosa, su aspecto también induce temor.
description_it: Forma finale della regina dei furfanti. Spada spietata, il cui aspetto incute timore.
description_zh: Power alone is not enough--the Roguemaster's final form has a truly despicable appeal.

name: Notos 1
description: A lost fragment? A memory of the past? Or an enigma sent to haunt our age?
description_de: Eine vergessene Erinnerung? Oder ein altes Rätsel, das unsere Zeit heimsuchen soll?
description_fr: Un fragment perdu ? Un souvenir ? Une énigme envoyée pour nous hanter ?
description_es: ¿Un fragmento perdido? ¿Un vestigio del pasado? ¿O un enigma moderno?
description_it: Un frammento perduto? Un ricordo del passato? O un enigma maledetto?

name: Euros 2
description: Notos's final form. A mystical blade beyond comprehension that harbors the power of a forgotten era.
description_de: Finale Form von Notos. Eine unbe- greifliche mystische Klinge, der die Macht verlorener Zeiten innewohnt.
description_fr: Cette lame mystique porte l'essence d'une ère oubliée. Base : Notos
description_es: Forma final de Notos. Una espada mística y arcana que alberga el poder de una era olvidada.
description_it: Forma finale della Notos. Una spada mitica e arcana che naconde il potere di un'era dimenticata.
description_zh: Notos's final form. A mystical blade beyond comprehension that harbors the power of a forgotten era.

name: Despot's Boltrunner 1
description: A peerless, regal edge that gleams with pale light. Tremble, ye gods, when this sword howls.
description_de: Königliche Schneide ohne Gleichen mit blassem Schimmer. Ihr Heulen lässt selbst Götter erzittern.
description_fr: Lame royale inégalée émettant une lueur pâle. Son hurlement fait trembler les dieux.
description_es: Una regia espada sin par que resplandece con una luz pálida. Los dioses tiemblan cuando aúlla.
description_it: Lama di rango reale che risplende di una luce pallida. Il suo sibilo fa tremare gli dei.
description_zh: A peerless, regal edge that gleams with pale light. Tremble, ye gods, when this sword howls.

name: Oppressor's Abyss 2
description: The Despot's Boltrunner's final form is capable of cleaving entire worlds. The populace bow before its might.
description_de: Finale Form des Despoten-Blitzren- ners. Seine Hiebe sind das Zeichen eines mächtigen Herrschers.
description_fr: Cette arme est capable de fendre des continents entiers en deux. Base : Éclair du despote
description_es: Forma final de Rebanarrayos déspota. Todos se inclinan ante su poder de partir el mundo en dos.
description_it: Forma finale della saetta del despota. Rade al suolo mondi interi. Tutti si inchinano al suo cospetto.
description_zh: The Despot's Boltrunner's final form is capable of cleaving entire worlds. The populace bow before its might.

description: Created through a Soaratorium refining process. Can also be used to measure defeated specimens.
description_de: Im Aerotorium entwicklelt. Kann auch besiegte Exemplare vermessen.
description_fr: Conçu par l'Aérolabo, il peut également servir à mesurer les spécimens vaincus.
description_es: Forjado en el Flotatorio. También se puede usar para medir a los ejemplares vencidos.
description_it: Realizzata tramite un processo di raffinazione del solcacieli. Serve anche per misurare nemici sconfitti.

name: Discovery Saber 2
description: The Research Saber's final form. As a wise man once said, wise is he who gets wise to the world.
description_de: Finale Form des Rätsel-Lang- schwerts. Ein Weiser sprach: "Wer Wissen erlangt, wird erleuchtet."
description_fr: Comme l'a dit un sage : "Prudence n'est que sagesse en application." Base : Sabre d'étude
description_es: Forma final de Sable investigación. Un sabio dijo que la sabiduría se mide por los actos sabios.
description_it: Forma finale della sciabola della ricerca. C'è chi dice che la saggezza sia un punto di vista sulle cose...

name: Rushin' Blue 1
description: The blue trim applied to the sheath has a paralytic effect. How darkly those red eyes shine!
description_de: Das blaue Band an der Scheide übt lähmenden Einfluss aus, während die Augen in dunklem Rot glitzern.
description_fr: Le ruban bleu qui orne son manche n'est pas qu'esthétique, il contient un agent paralysant.
description_es: El lazo azul de la vaina provoca parálisis. Sus ojos brillan con un color rojo intenso.
description_it: Il tocco di blu applicato al fodero ha il potere di paralizzare il nemico e gli occhi rossi luccicano.
description_zh: The blue trim applied to the sheath has a paralytic effect. How darkly those red eyes shine!

name: Catatonia 2
description: The Rushin' Blue's final form meshes two conflicting colors to transfix the mind in a discordant harmony.
description_de: Finale Form des Rauschenden Blau. Zwei kontrastierende Farben ver- setzen den Verstand in Disharmonie.
description_fr: Ses tonalités représentent l'agitation habitant un esprit tourmenté. Base : Bleu roussi
description_es: La forma final de Azul de Miausia junta dos colores opuestos para crear una armonía discordante.
description_it: Forma finale della Blumiao laccata. Unisce due colori contrastanti che creano un'armonia discordante.
description_zh: The Rushin' Blue's final form meshes two conflicting colors to transfix the mind in a discordant harmony.

name: Purre Catatonia 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Rushin' Blue.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe des Rauschenden Blau.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Bleu roussi.
description_es: Forma perfecta Azul de Miausia que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della Blumiao laccata.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Rushin' Blue.

name: Elder Saber 1
description: A Long Sword from the Soaratorium for hunters breaking new ground. Severs prey effortlessly in twain.
description_de: Von der Wykademie für Jäger erdacht, die sich auf Neuland wa- gen. Die scharfe Klinge fällt Beute.
description_fr: Conçu par l'Aérolabo pour les chasseurs à l'avant-garde, il fend vos proies en deux avec aise.
description_es: Espada larga forjada en el Flotatorio para cazadores pioneros. Cercena al rival en dos.
description_it: Spada lunga del solcacieli per il cacciatore pioniere. Taglia facilmente la preda in due.
description_zh: A Long Sword from the Soaratorium for hunters breaking new ground. Severs prey effortlessly in twain.

name: Sage Saber 2
description: The Elder Saber's final form. Its crimson blade cuts through all known matter.
description_de: Finale Form des Ältesten-Säbels. Die Schnitte der rot schimmernden Klinge durchdringen alles.
description_fr: Son tranchant écarlate peut tailler à travers n'importe quelle matière. Base : Sabre des anciens

description_de: Eine Morph-Axt, die Seelen ins Leben nach dem Tod führt. Sie zerteilt das Dunkel.
description_fr: Morpho-hache qui pourfend les ténèbres. Elle sert celui qui guide les âmes dans l'au-delà.
description_es: Hacha espada que guía a las almas a la otra vida. Su brillo se abre camino en la oscuridad.
description_it: Spad-ascia appartenuta a colui che guida le anime nell'aldilà. Fende persino le tenebre.

description_es: Hacha espada con ojos. La lengua hambrienta va a por la presa veloz como el viento.

name: Ruiner's Bane 1
description: Despair was fated to return to the world, as was the fabled axe to be used again.

name: Amber Slash 1
description: A lovely hunting axe made from the tri-color Barioth. Cold enough to freeze blood.

description_zh: A Switch Axe made from superior Barioth fangs. All who meet it suffer the grave's cold embrace.

description: The Noble Gunbird's final form. The special weapon of a unit which served an empress in many battles.

description_fr: Lancecanon portant la magie des oiseaux nocturnes. Plonge ses proies dans un cauchemar éternel.
description_es: Lanza pistola cuyo color recuerda al plumaje de un ave nocturna. Sume a sus víctimas en una pesadilla.
description_it: Lancia-fucile con i colori degli uccelli notturni. Un solo colpo fa cadere in un sonno popolato da incubi.

description_de: Finale Form des Schlafsprengers. Ihre albtraumhaften Angriffe sind so verführerisch wie grausam.
description_fr: Ses attaques plongent sa proie dans un éternel sommeil de souffrances. Base : Artificier dormeur
description_es: Forma final de Asoladora durmiente. Basta un único disparo para sumir a sus presas en una pesadilla eterna.
description_it: Forma finale dello sparasonno. Un solo colpo e la preda cadrà in un sonno eterno da incubo.

description_es: Forma final de Lanza pistola barbacoa. Es tan potente que reduce a cenizas todo lo que toca.

description_fr: Arc dont les flèches occultent même le soleil. Capable de mettre le monde entier à genoux.
description_es: Arco capaz de bloquear el sol. La tempestad creada al tensarlo puede someter al mundo entero.
description_it: Può oscurare persino il sole. La sua corda genera folate in grado di sferzare il mondo.

name: Kingdomfall 1
description: A Bow crafted from the core of a Lao-Shan Lung horn. Drawing it is a matter of soul, not power.
description_de: Nutzt den Kern eines Lao-Shan- Lung-Horns. Statt Zugkraft wird Seelenkraft benötigt.
description_fr: À base d'une corne de Lao-Shan Lung. Bander cet arc est un acte spirituel, non de force.
description_es: Usa el núcleo de un cuerno de Lao-Shan. Se usa con el corazón, no con la fuerza.
description_it: Un arco di corno di Lao-Shan Lung. Il suo potere deriva dal cuore di chi lo impugna, non dalla sua forza.
description_zh: A Bow crafted from the core of a Lao-Shan Lung horn. Drawing it is a matter of soul, not power.

name: Mountainfall 2
description: The Kingdomfall's final form. The wind from its arrows can bring down the mountains.
description_de: Finale Form des Königreichsturzes. Mit seinen Pfeilen können übersinnlich Begabte Berge spalten.
description_fr: L'air généré par ses flèches suffit à abattre des montagnes. Base : Arc dragon terre
description_es: Forma final de Arco dragón de tierra. Solo para quienes posean una visión excelente.
description_it: Forma finale dell'arco-drago Terra. Le sue frecce creano un vento che erode le montagne più dure.
description_zh: The Kingdomfall's final form. The wind from its arrows can bring down the mountains.

name: Heavensfall 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Kingdomfall.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe des Königreichsturzes.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Arc dragon terre.
description_es: Forma perfecta Arco dragón de tierra que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore dell'arco-drago Terra.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Kingdomfall.

name: Bow of Toil & Turmoil 1
description: A black Bow that harnesses Fatalis's power. A single shot loosed from its string unleashes a ruinous whirlwind.
description_de: Ein schwarzer Bogen mit der Kraft eines Fatalis. Ein finsterer Chaosbringer.
description_fr: Arc noir doté des pouvoirs d'un dragon maléfique. Un seul tir déclenche le chaos.
description_es: Arco negro con el poder de un dragón malévolo. Úsalo y causarás el caos.
description_it: Arco nero con il potere di un drago infernale. Un tiro con l'arco causa il caos.
name_zh: 击灭与破坏之刚弓 - Lv.1
description_zh: A black Bow that harnesses Fatalis's power. A single shot loosed from its string unleashes a ruinous whirlwind.

name: Bow of Rack & Ruin 2
description: The Bow of Toil & Turmoil's final form. The whir of its wicked arrows sing a prelude to destruction.
description_de: Finale Form von Furcht und Fäulnis. Seine Pfeile singen die Ouvertüre des Untergangs.
description_fr: Entonne un prélude à la dévastation avant de tirer ses flèches. Base : Arc de la tourmente
description_es: Forma final de Choque y desolación. El silbido de las flechas precede a la destrucción que desata.
description_it: Forma finale dell'arco fatica e tumulto. Il sibilo delle sue frecce è un preludio di distruzione.
name_zh: 歼灭与摧毁之刚弓 - Lv.2
description_zh: The Bow of Toil & Turmoil's final form. The whir of its wicked arrows sing a prelude to destruction.

description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Arc de la tourmente.
description_es: Forma perfecta Choque y desolación que se ha refinado al máximo.

name_zh: 断灭与崩坏之刚烈弓 - Lv.3

name: Bow of Ire & Anguish 1
description: A bloodstained bow imbued with the power of a crimson Fatalis that drives the user into a brutal rage.
description_de: Blutiger Bogen mit der Kraft eines karmesinroten Fatalis. Wer ihn spannt, bringt Unglück über die Welt.
description_fr: Contient la puissance du Fatalis rouge. Son porteur ressent la rage et vise la destruction du monde.
description_es: Arco que alberga el poder de un Fatalis carmesí. Al tensar la cuerda, sume a su víctima en una ira ciega.
description_it: Arco imbrattato di sangue che racchiude la potenza del Fatalis cremisi e la furia più brutale.
name_zh: 愤怒与惨祸之爆弓 - Lv.1
description_zh: A bloodstained bow imbued with the power of a crimson Fatalis that drives the user into a brutal rage.

name: Bow of Jinx & Jeopardy 2
description: The Bow of Ire & Anguish's final form. Its dire arrows are a preface to the coming rage and calamity.
description_de: Finale Form von Zorn und Zaudern. Seine Pfeile sind Vorboten des Unheils.
description_fr: Ses flèches impitoyables annoncent l'arrivée des sombres heures. Base : Arc du courroux
description_es: Forma final de Ira y debacle. Las flechas que lanza son el heraldo de la destrucción.
description_it: Forma finale dell'arco ira e angoscia. Le sue frecce sono la prefazione della furia e calamità.
name_zh: 盛怒与灾祸之爆弓 - Lv.2
description_zh: The Bow of Ire & Anguish's final form. Its dire arrows are a preface to the coming rage and calamity.

description_es: Forma perfecta Ira y debacle que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore dell'arco ira e angoscia.
name_zh: 震怒与大祸之爆裂弓 - Lv.3
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Bow of Ire & Anguish.

name: Glory and Grandeur 1
description: A divine Bow forged from the soul of an old Fatalis. The pure of heart will be blessed with many victories.
description_de: Weißer Bogen, dem die Seele eines alten Fatalis innewohnen soll. Bezwingt die Finsternis.
description_fr: Arc blanc censé contenir l'âme d'un dragon ancien. Dissipateur de ténèbres.
description_es: Arco divino que alberga el alma del Fatalis ancestral. Con él, solo logran la victoria quienes sean puros.
description_it: Arco divino ricavato dall'anima del Fatalis antico. I puri di cuore saranno ricompensati con molte vittorie.
name_zh: 胜利与荣光之勇弓 - Lv.1
description_zh: A divine Bow forged from the soul of an old Fatalis. The pure of heart will be blessed with many victories.

name: Might and Marvel 2
description: Glory and Grandeur's final form. Arrows in flight from this hallowed bow forge the way to conquest.
description_de: Finale Form von Ruhm und Reichtum. Die Pfeile dieses weißen Götterbogens führen zu großer Ehre.
description_fr: Les flèches de cet arc sacré montrent le chemin de la victoire. Base : Gloire et Grandeur
description_es: Forma final de Victoria gloriosa. Sus sagradas flechas abren el camino hacia el éxito rutilante.
description_it: Forma finale di gloria e vittoria. Le sue frecce sacre ti guideranno verso la meritata vittoria.
name_zh: 完胜与荣誉之勇弓 - Lv.2

name: Lightbreak Bow 1
description: A Bow that shoots with explosive force. Take down prey Brachydios- style: more "bang" for your buck.
description_de: Dieser Bogen schießt Pfeile aus Licht mit der Geschwindigkeit eines Brachydios auf die Beute.
description_fr: Arc envoyant des flèches de lumière à la vitesse explosive du Brachydios vers les proies.
description_es: Arco que lanza flechas de luz hacia la presa a la velocidad de un Brachydios.
description_it: Arco che scaglia frecce di luce verso la preda con la velocità esplosiva di un Brachydios.
description_zh: A Bow that shoots with explosive force. Take down prey Brachydios- style: more "bang" for your buck.

name: Lightbreak Burstshot 2
description: The Lightbreak Bow's final form. Its hail of explosive arrows render the very land uninhabitable.
description_de: Finale Form des Lichtbruch-Bogens. Seine Explosivpfeile regnen herab und erledigen alle Beute auf einmal.
description_fr: Ses flèches semblent tomber du ciel pour abattre ses cibles. Base : Arc de lumière
description_es: Forma final de Arco parterrayos. Devasta todo a su paso con una lluvia de flechas explosivas.
description_it: Forma finale dell'arco d'alba. Le sue frecce esplosive rendono la terra una landa invivibile.
description_zh: The Lightbreak Bow's final form. Its hail of explosive arrows render the very land uninhabitable.

description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore dell'arco d'alba.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Lightbreak Bow.

name: Gewinn/Perte 1
description: A Bow whose Affinity changes when its wielder overcomes the Frenzy.
description_de: Ein Bogen, der die Affinität wechselt, wenn sein Träger die Raserei überwindet.
description_fr: Arc dont l'affinité change quand son porteur triomphe du virus de la furie.
description_es: Un arco cuya afinidad cambia cuando su portador supera la cólera.
description_it: Arco la cui affinità muta quando chi lo brandisce debella la frenesia.
description_zh: A Bow whose Affinity changes when its wielder overcomes the Frenzy.

name: Verzweiflung/Désir 2
description: The Gewinn/Perte's final form. Shows its true potential only to those who cling to hope.
description_de: Finale Form von Gewinn und Verlust. Die Waffe wählt sich einen Jäger, der seine Hoffnung nie aufgibt.
description_fr: Ne révèle son véritable potentiel qu'à ceux qui gardent espoir. Base : Perte et Gain
description_es: Forma final de Gewinn/Pérdida. Muestra su verdadero potencial solo a quienes no se desaniman.
description_it: Forma finale di Gewinn-Perte. Svela il suo vero potenziale solo a coloro che non perdono mai la speranza.
description_zh: The Gewinn/Perte's final form. Shows its true potential only to those who cling to hope.

description_fr: Arc fait avec les deux cornes d'un Diablos. Requiert une grande force.
description_es: Un arco hecho con cuernos de Diablos. Tensarlo requiere una gran fuerza.
description_it: Arco realizzato con parti di Diablos. Richiede una forza notevole per essere usato.
description_zh: A bow made from Diablos's resilient horns. It takes an absurd amount of strength to pull back the bowstring.

description_fr: Avec un tel pouvoir, la rage d'un tyran n'aurait pas de limite. Base : Spire Diablos
description_es: Forma final de Diablos enroscacola. Ni una horda de enemigos podría vencer a quien lo porte.
description_it: Forma finale dell'arcorno cera. Il potere di un tiranno racchiude una ferocia senza limiti.

description: A prized hunting Bow that really packs a punch. You've got to put your back into it to move this one!
description_de: Von enormer Kraft. Kann nur von starker Hand gezogen werden.
description_fr: Très puissant. Ne peut être bandé que par ceux ayant une force suffisante.
description_es: Rezuma un gran poder, pero solo los más fuertes son capaces de tensarlo.
description_it: Vanta un grande potere. Può essere teso solo da chi è forte abbastanza.

description: A Bow plated with Barioth scales. Boasts a relatively high critical attack rate and Ice damage.
description_de: Bogen mit weißen Barioth- Platten. Jäger schätzen Eis- eigenschaften und Affinität.
description_fr: Arc en plaque blanche de Barioth. Propriétés de glace et affinité élevée.
description_es: Un arco cubierto de escamas de Barioth. Tiene propiedades de hielo y aumenta la afinidad.
description_it: Arco con piastre di Barioth. Offre un'alta affinità e le proprietà del ghiaccio.

description: The Ice Crest's final form, which uses a spike as a stabilizer. See the white petals bloom, inviolate and noble.

name: Ultimus Celestials 1
description: A most evil pair. They have passed through many hands via an inescapable chain of death.

description_es: El arma más malvada. Pasó por muchas manos dejando un reguero de muerte negra.
description_it: Arma di grande malvagità, è passata di mano in mano con una lunga scia di violenze.
description_zh: A most evil pair. They have passed through many hands via an inescapable chain of death.

name: Agnaktor Inferno 2
description: The final form of the Ignis Noire. Tempered to increase its durability, its very touch burns prey to cinders.
description_de: Finale Form von Ignis Noire. Diese unverwüstlichen Doppelklingen grillen die Beute mit ihrer Hitze.
description_fr: Ces lames incandescentes brûlent et fauchent leurs proies. Base : Ignis Noire
description_es: Forma final de Ignis Noire. Armas de durabilidad mayor. Achicharran a sus víctimas.
description_it: Forma finale del fuoco nero. Temprato per aumentarne la durata, incenerisce le prede al solo tocco.
description_zh: The final form of the Ignis Noire. Tempered to increase its durability, its very touch burns prey to cinders.

name: Scoria Agnaktor 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ignis Noire.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe von Ignis Noire.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Ignis Noire.
description_es: Forma perfecta Ignis Noire que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore del fuoco nero.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ignis Noire.

name: Verdant Slashers 1
description: Dual Blades made from the fins of a Plesioth. The webbing contains both water and sleep elements.
description_de: Doppelklingen aus extrem flinken Plesioth-Flossen mit robusten, scharfen Schneiden.
description_fr: Lames doubles en nageoires agiles de Plesioth. Imprégnées des éléments eau et sommeil.
description_es: Hojas dobles hechas de aleta de Plesioth. Las membranas contienen elementos de agua y de sueño.
description_it: Lame doppie realizzate con le pinne di Plesioth. La membrana contiene sia acqua che elementi soporiferi.
description_zh: Dual Blades made from the fins of a Plesioth. The webbing contains both water and sleep elements.

name: Alluvion Slashers 2
description: Final form of the Verdant Slashers. The twin elements contained in the blades consign any foe to oblivion.
description_de: Finale Form der Grünen Schlitzer. Ihre Doppelattribut-Kombos bereiten der Beute ein stilles Grab.
description_fr: Le double attribut élémentaire des lames terrasse l'ennemi. Base : Trancheuses vertes
description_es: Forma final de Tajadores verdes. El abrazo dulce pero mortal de sus membranas es bien conocido.
description_it: Forma finale degli slasher verdi. Gli elementi gemelli delle lame annientano qualsiasi nemico.
description_zh: Final form of the Verdant Slashers. The twin elements contained in the blades consign any foe to oblivion.

name: Torporfall Slashers 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Verdant Slashers.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Grünen Schlitzer.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Trancheuses vertes.
description_es: Forma perfecta Tajadores verdes que se han refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore degli slasher verdi.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Verdant Slashers.

name: Research Spikes 1
description: Shaped like a ship's wheel, these were created to commemorate the maiden flight of the Soaratorium.
description_de: Zur Einweihung des Aerotoriums ge- fertigt. Beide zusammen bilden ein Steuerrad. Überraschend effektiv.
description_fr: Créées pour commémorer la mise en service de l'Aérolabo, elles évoquent un gouvernail.
description_es: Forjadas para conmemorar el primer viaje del Flotatorio. Tienen forma de timón.
description_it: A forma di timone di aeronave, sono state create per celebrare il volo inaugurale del solcacieli.
description_zh: Shaped like a ship's wheel, these were created to commemorate the maiden flight of the Soaratorium.

name: Discovery Spikes 2
description: The final form of the Research Spikes. A wise person knows how to sail rough seas as well as calm.
description_de: Finale Form der Rätsel-Doppelklin- gen. Ein Weiser sprach: "Die größten Geister lenken Revolutionen."
description_fr: "Qui cherche la sagesse doit voguer sur une mer changeante." Base : Lames d'étude
description_es: Forma final de Púas investigación. "Solo los sabios saben navegar en aguas tranquilas y bravas."
description_it: Forma finale delle punte della ricerca. Il saggio sa come navigare in acque calme o tempestose.
name_zh: 久经钻研之龙识双剑 - Lv.2
description_zh: The final form of the Research Spikes. A wise person knows how to sail rough seas as well as calm.

name: Cercatore Talea 1
description: Favored weapons of the manager of the Hunters' Pub -- back when she was still hunting, of course.
description_de: Früher Lieblingswaffe der Tavernen- Managerin - damals, als sie selbst noch jagte.
description_fr: L'arme de service préférée de la Taulière. Enfin, à l'époque où elle chassait encore.
description_es: Arma favorita de la dueña de la taberna "El cuerno". De cuando se dedicaba a cazar monstruos, claro.
description_it: Le armi preferite della manager della taverna... Quando ancora era solita cacciare, ovviamente.
description_zh: Favored weapons of the manager of the Hunters' Pub -- back when she was still hunting, of course.

name: Sucher Azalee 2
description: Final form of the Cercatore Talea. Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor Rathian stops these hunters.
description_de: Finale Form der Cercatore Talea. Wer sie führt, muss auf seine Jäger- ehre schwören, nie aufzugeben.
description_fr: Cette arme porte toute la fierté du chasseur. Plus rien ne doit passer ! Base : Cercatore Talea
description_es: Forma final de Cercatore Talea. Portarla es un orgullo para cualquier cazador. Su poder es imparable.
description_it: Forma finale del Cercatore Talea. Niente e nessuno può fermare questi cacciatori.
description_zh: Final form of the Cercatore Talea. Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor Rathian stops these hunters.

name: Chercher Ultime 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Cercatore Talea.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Cercatore Talea.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Cercatore Talea.
description_es: Forma perfecta Cercatore Talea que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore del Cercatore Talea.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Cercatore Talea.

name: Ace Blades 1
description: The Ace Commander's Dual Blades of choice. They lend a certain dashing, if a bit sinister, air.
description_de: Lieblingswaffe des Ass-Komman- danten. Passt zu schwarzer Trauer- kleidung. So kühn wie unheilvoll.
description_fr: Une élégance sinistre émane de l'arme de prédilection du Commandant d'élite.
description_es: Armas favoritas del comandante de élite, cubiertas de esmalte tan negro como el resentimiento.
description_it: Le doppie lame preferite dal Grancomandante. Emanano un certo fascino, anche se un po' sinistre.
description_zh: The Ace Commander's Dual Blades of choice. They lend a certain dashing, if a bit sinister, air.

name: Loyal Ace Blades 2
description: The final form of the Ace Blades. A strong and just heart can overcome any hardship.
description_de: Finale Form der Ass-Klingen. Überwindet das wilde Wehklagen mit dem Geist der Gerechtigkeit.
description_fr: Elle puise dans la justice la force de dépasser les peines les plus cruelles. Base : Lames d'As
description_es: Forma final de Hojas de élite. Poseen un espíritu justiciero dispuesto a acabar con la pena y el caos.
description_it: Forma finale delle lame Grancaccia. Un cuore forte e giusto è in grado di superare qualsiasi avversità.
description_zh: The final form of the Ace Blades. A strong and just heart can overcome any hardship.

name: The Commander 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ace Blades.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Ass-Klingen.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Lames d'As.
description_es: Forma perfecta Hojas de élite que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore delle lame Grancaccia.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Ace Blades.

name: Luzio Saurel 1
description: A fishy set of Dual Blades carried by d'Artanyan. Their cutting ability is second to meowne!
description_de: D'Artagnans Doppelklingen in Fischform. Sehen lustig aus, sind aber schärfer als alles andere!
description_fr: Cette arme superbe aux motifs de poisson est celle de D'Artamiaou. Par contre, elle donne faim.
description_es: Espadas dobles con forma de pez que porta D'Artamiau. ¡Cuidado, están muy afiladas!
description_it: Lame doppie a forma di pesce che appartengono a d'Artamian. Taglienti come nient'altro al mondo.
description_zh: A fishy set of Dual Blades carried by d'Artanyan. Their cutting ability is second to meowne!

name: Rufio Kingfish 2
description: The final form of the Luzio Saurel. You won't be a fish out of water on the battlefield with these blades.
description_de: Finale Form der Luzio-Sardinen. Zischen herum wie ein Fisch im Wasser!
description_fr: Pour être comme un poisson dans l'eau sur le champ de bataille. Base : Sardine Luzio
description_es: Forma final de Sardina Lucio. Con ellas te moverás en combate como pez en el agua.
description_it: Forma finale del Suro Luzio. Con queste lame in battaglia non ti sentirai come un pesce fuor d'acqua.
description_zh: The final form of the Luzio Saurel. You won't be a fish out of water on the battlefield with these blades.

name: Establi Mako 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Luzio Saurel.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Luzio-Sardinen.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Sardine Luzio.
description_es: Forma perfecta Sardina Lucio que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore del Suro Luzio.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Luzio Saurel.

name: Elder Daggers 1
description: Dual Blades from the Soaratorium for hunters breaking new ground. They are as light as feathers.
description_de: Von der Wykademie für Jäger erdacht, die sich auf Neuland wa- gen. Klingen, leicht wie Flügel.
description_fr: Conçues par la Wycadémie pour les chasseurs à l'avant-garde, elles sont légères comme une plume.
description_es: Espadas dobles ideadas en el Flotatorio para cazadores pioneros. Son ligeras como una pluma.
description_it: Lame doppie del solcacieli. Leggere come piume e adatte ai cacciatori più avventurosi.
description_zh: Dual Blades from the Soaratorium for hunters breaking new ground. They are as light as feathers.

name: Sage Daggers 2
description: Final form of the Elder Daggers. They tear your quarry to pieces with unbelievable swiftness.
description_de: Finale Form der Ältesten-Dolche. Noch härter, noch schneller - das Auge kann kaum folgen.
description_fr: Elles tranchent leurs proies sans aucune pitié. Base : Dagues des anciens
description_es: Forma final de Dagas atávicas. Despedazan a sus víctimas sin compasión.
description_it: Forma finale dei pugnali dell'anziano. Affettano la preda con una precisione incredibile.
description_zh: Final form of the Elder Daggers. They tear your quarry to pieces with unbelievable swiftness.

name: Philosopher Daggers 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Elder Daggers.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Ältesten-Dolche.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Dagues des anciens.
description_es: Forma perfecta Dagas atávicas que se han refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore dei pugnali dell'anziano.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Elder Daggers.

name: Jinrai Works 1
description: Dual Blades from a distant land. The left builds charge and the right directs it.
description_de: Doppelklingen aus einem fernen Land. Die linke baut Spannung auf, die rechte leitet sie.
description_fr: Doubles lames d'un pays lointain. L'une produit de l'énergie, l'autre l'utilise.
description_es: Procedentes de otro mundo. Una hoja carga este arma y la otra hace el ataque.
description_it: La lama sinistra crea una carica e la destra la dirige al bersaglio.
description_zh: Dual Blades from a distant land. The left builds charge and the right directs it.

name: Gorai Works 2
description: Jinrai Works's final form. Turns enemies to dust, leaving only a dazzling arc.
description_de: Finale Form der Jinrai-Klingen. Nach ihrem Donnerschlag bleibt von Feinden nur Staub.
description_fr: Derrière elle, il ne reste que de la poussière. Base : Création Jinrai
description_es: Forma final de Jinrai Works. Dejan tras de sí un reguero de destrucción total.
description_it: Forma finale delle lame Jinrai. Riducono i nemici in polvere.
description_zh: Jinrai Works's final form. Turns enemies to dust, leaving only a dazzling arc.

name: Dengeki Daggers 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Jinrai Works.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungs- stufe der Jinrai-Klingen.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Création Jinrai.
description_es: Forma perfecta Jinrai Works que se han refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore delle lame Jinrai.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Jinrai Works.

name: Light Sword Cypher 1
description: An assassin's blade that is as quick as lightning and as unrelenting as death itself.
description_de: Die Klinge eines Attentäters, so schnell wie der Blitz und so unerbittlich wie der Tod selbst.
description_fr: Rapide comme la foudre, cette arme est aussi implacable que la mort elle-même.
description_es: Cuchilla de asesino. Rápida como el rayo e inevitable como la misma muerte.
description_it: Lama da assassino, rapida come un fulmine e inesorabile come la morte stessa.
description_zh: An assassin's blade that is as quick as lightning and as unrelenting as death itself.

name: Light Sword Cypher X 2
description: The Light Sword Cypher's final form, trusted only in the hands of Special A-Class Striders.
description_de: Finalform des Plasma-Schwerts Cypher, treu in der Hand eines speziellen A-Klasse Striders.
description_fr: Utilisé uniquement par les Striders de classe S. Base : Sabre plasma Cypher
description_es: Forma final de Cuchilla Cypher. Solo se la confía a manos de Striders de clase A.
description_it: Forma finale della lama plasma Cypher. Affidata solo agli Strider di Classe-A speciale.
description_zh: The Light Sword Cypher's final form, trusted only in the hands of Special A-Class Striders.

name: Light Sword Cypher X 3
description: The Light Sword Cypher's final form, trusted only in the hands of Special A-Class Striders.

description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe des Plasma-Schwerts Cypher.

description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della lama plasma Cypher.

name: Obsidian Horn 1
description: A Hunting Horn made from a fossil. Steeped in history, it carries a vibrant tone.
description_de: Jagdhorn, gefertigt aus einem Fossil. Sein Klang ist ein Echo seiner langen Geschichte.
description_fr: Corne de chasse taillée dans un fossile. Un pan d'histoire à la tonalité dynamique.
description_es: Cornamusa hecha con un fósil. Con un pasado glorioso, emite un tono vibrante.
description_it: Corno da caccia ricavato da un fossile. Profuma di storia ed emette note vibranti.
description_zh: A Hunting Horn made from a fossil. Steeped in history, it carries a vibrant tone.

name: Altair 1
description: A glaive powerful enough to cut even the wind. Evading repeatedly while drawn restores some Sharpness.
description_de: Durchschneidet sogar den Wind. Einmal gezogen, macht wiederholtes Ausweichen sie wieder schärfer.
description_fr: Aussi acéré que le vent. Esquivez pour restaurer le tranchant (arme dégainée).
description_es: Poderoso glaive capaz de cortar el viento. Esquivar varias veces arma en mano recupera afilado.
description_it: Tanto potente da tagliare il vento. Schivando più volte dopo averlo estratto ne ripristini l'acutezza.
description_zh: A glaive powerful enough to cut even the wind. Evading repeatedly while drawn restores some Sharpness.

name: Hidden Scythe 1
description: A glaive made for hunting in the dark. Even the blackest of nights cannot hide its victims.

description_it: Falcione perfetto per le cacce al buio. Scova le sue vittime anche nelle notti più oscure.
